svg.title: 6a. Sequence - turn 4: a VIP arrives, Happy Hour is switched on, the order is taken and cooked

g.text: 6a. Sequence - turn 4: a VIP arrives, Happy Hour is switched on, the order is taken and cooked
Both parts (6a and 6b) run inside GameController.play():
(no early ending). Each turn: staff.startTurn(), then steps 1-5.
Manager choice that changes the outcome:
the VIP's bill will be $10.80 instead of $13.50
